thread:
Tess: Quick async standup for the staggered rollout slice — post any updates/blockers. Keeping it short: what happened yesterday / any blockers / next 2h?
Ana: infra - KV cache priming finished on canary nodes at ~08:40 UTC. No disk pressure, but one node had a transient GPU driver restart, recovered. Watching it. :eyes:
Mike: deploy - rolled canary to 3% at 08:50, bumped to 5% at 09:10. Seeing a small uptick in 502s from the routing tier (0.6% -> 1.8%). Investigating logs now.
Leo: FYI I shipped a small routing fallback patch in PR 5423: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/5423 — it changes the retry backoff to 50ms -> 150ms for transient gateway errors. Can reviewers please take a look?
Sarah: product - telemetry is mostly green. We did catch one prompt edge-case where embeddings quality dips for long contexts (sample id: s-83f2). Not critical for the roll, but wanted to flag.
Eli: oncall - I wired a temporary alert for gateway 5xx spike at 1.2% (was 1%). Created a silence for noisier infra alerts for the next 90m.
deploy-bot: deployment v2.7.3-canary started by @Mike at 1955555400, targets: slice-A (5%), slice-B (0%). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/v/2.7.3/canary
Mike: digging into the 502s — tailing the gateway logs shows backend HTTP timeouts hitting ~2s for some requests. Possible connection reuse bug with the proxy. Reverting a config change from yesterday to test.
Tess: blocker? if the spike stays >1% we halt ramp and run failover to fallback-model. Mike, do you want us to stop further ramp until patch?
Mike: propose pause ramp at 6% hold. Patch queued and running a subset canary with the patch (slice-A subset). If new 5xx rate drops to <0.8% in 15m we continue. Otherwise rollback to v2.7.2.
Ana: confirmed KV cache still primed. No replication lag seen. Will prewarm additional workers if we proceed to 20%.
Leo: reviewers on PR 5423: @Ana @Sarah — pinged. If urgent I can merge with +1 from infra lead.
Sarah: product approves emergency merge if it fixes 502s. We prefer a quick canary subset test before global ramp.
Eli: I've documented rollback steps in the runbook and assigned myself as owner for the next 60m.
Tess: perfect — plan is: hold at 6% for 15m, validate 5xx <0.8% and embedding quality stable. If green, continue ramp to 20% with observation. If not, rollback per runbook. Ping here with final decision. :thumbsup:
